features.name: planar square arena
features.notes: Approximately 120 by 120 studs with main action on one horizontal plane
features.quote: Overall arena: approximately 120 by 120 studs... Main action takes place on one horizontal plane.

features.name: continuous winding enemy lane
features.notes: Single unbranching lane from spawn to core with no dead ends or ambiguous self crossings
features.quote: A single continuous, unchanging lane winding from spawn to the core

features.name: long firing straightaway
features.quote: A long straightaway where towers can fire along the path.

features.name: central curved lane bend
features.notes: Central bend or loop along route
features.quote: A central bend or loop where radial towers become powerful but hazardous.

features.name: narrow track pinch point
features.notes: Visible lane narrowing for concentrated enemy waves
features.quote: Track Pinch Point: A narrowing in the lane where waves bunch up

features.name: flanking tower placement grids
features.notes: Flat structural zones on both sides of track
features.quote: Flat structural zones framing both sides of the track where players click to deploy defenders.

features.name: open dodging spaces
features.notes: Open areas around route with minimal tall cover
features.quote: Open spaces that allow projectile dodging. No tall geometry that frequently hides the player or bullets.

features.name: enemy spawn point
features.quote: Spawn the player... Enemies follow a fixed route toward a core.

features.name: large core base
features.notes: At end of enemy path and visual defense focus
features.quote: The core is located at the end of the enemy path.

features.name: three tower silhouettes
features.notes: Distinct Sentry, Scatter Tower, and Pulse Tower models

features.name: radial pulse warning effects
features.notes: Charge glow and contracting ring around Pulse Tower before burst
features.quote: Uses a charge glow, contracting ring, and warning sound.

features.name: three enemy silhouettes
features.notes: Distinct Scrapper medium, Runner small, and Brute large models

features.name: engineer player character
features.notes: Physically present in arena with wrench
features.quote: The player controls an engineer who is physically present in a 3D tower-defense arena.

features.name: hovering scrap pickups
features.notes: Physical drops near defeated enemies with small horizontal offsets
features.quote: Enemies must drop physical Scrap pickups at their death positions.
